NOTES: summary=Echo session output to a secondary transcript file. ; syntax=SET ALTERNATE ON|OFF | SET ALTERNATE TO <file>

summary=Fox-style spelling routed to the SETCASE handler. Direct SETCASE remains independently registered in the command registry, which is why it resolves through two paths. ; syntax=SET CASE ON|OFF ; aliases=SETCASE
summary=LMDB-index-profile command, routed to the SETCDX handler. ; syntax=SET CDX [TO] <container.cdx> ; build-gate=DOTTALK_WITH_INDEX
summary=Available in BOTH legacy and LMDB index profiles, unlike CDX and LMDB which are LMDB-profile only. ; syntax=SET CNX [TO] <container.cnx> ; build-gate=DOTTALK_HAS_XINDEX
summary=Fox-style alias for PRN TO CONSOLE / PRN TO NULL. ; syntax=SET CONSOLE ON|OFF

summary=Hide (ON) or show (OFF) records flagged deleted. Note the sense: ON means HIDE, which the status line spells out because the polarity is a routine source of confusion. ; syntax=SET DELETED ON|OFF

summary=Control PASSIVE startup and shutdown diagnostics in dev builds, including the relations BOOT trace. Does NOT trace ongoing relation refresh -- no such diagnostic exists. Explicit command traces stay under their own surfaces. Bare form reports current state. ; syntax=SET DEVDIAG | SET DEVDIAG ON|OFF | SET DEVDIAG STATUS|CHECK

summary=Fox-style alias for PRN. TO is required. PRINTER with no name stages the default printer. CONSOLE is accepted as a synonym for SCREEN, and OFF for NULL; neither synonym appears in SetUsageText. ; syntax=SET DEVICE TO SCREEN|CONSOLE | SET DEVICE TO FILE <path> | SET DEVICE TO PRINTER [name] | SET DEVICE TO NULL|OFF
summary=Echo each input line before executing it. Primarily for scripts. ; syntax=SET ECHO ON|OFF
summary=Choose the external editor. TO is REQUIRED here, unlike LANGUAGE or ERRORSTOP where it is optional. ; syntax=SET EDITOR TO <command> | SET EDITOR TO DEFAULT | SET EDITOR TO OFF

summary=Compatibility form of the native STOP_ON_ERROR command. Sets the severity at which a running DotScript aborts, compared against the severity carried by the recorded canonical error code. Strips an inline && comment before parsing. Bare form reports the threshold. AIF-067: absent from SetUsageText, so previously undiscoverable. ; syntax=SET ERRORSTOP | SET ERRORSTOP [TO] OFF|WARNING|ERROR
summary=Routed to the SETFILTER handler. Developer/transitional surface. ; syntax=SET FILTER TO <expr> ; build-gate=DOTTALK_WITH_DEV
summary=Routed to the SETINDEX handler. Present only when the index subsystem is compiled in. ; syntax=SET INDEX TO <file> ; build-gate=DOTTALK_HAS_XINDEX

summary=Transactional in-COMMIT index maintenance. Default OFF keeps the legacy batch behaviour (BUILDLMDB / REBUILD / REINDEX); ON enables incremental maintenance inside COMMIT for the active CDX/LMDB backend. Deliberately message-catalog-free (print_line), so it is NOT localized -- unlike its ladder siblings. AIF-067: absent from SetUsageText, so previously undiscoverable. ; syntax=SET INDEXTXN | SET INDEXTXN ON|OFF | SET INDEXTXN STATUS|CHECK | SET INDEXTXN USAGE|HELP|?

summary=Select the active message-rendering locale. Does NOT localize command keywords; it selects message text templates (AIF-066). Bare form reports current locale rather than erroring. ; syntax=SET LANGUAGE | SET LANGUAGE [TO] <en-US|es|fr|de|it|DEFAULT> | SET LANGUAGE CHECK|VALIDATE|CATALOG | SET LANGUAGE REPORT|EXPORT [locale] | SET LANGUAGE STATUS ; aliases=LOCALE
summary=LMDB-index-profile command, routed to the SETLMDB handler. See AIF-065 for the mapsize ladder defect on the writer side. ; syntax=SET LMDB <args...> ; build-gate=DOTTALK_WITH_INDEX

summary=Inspect and exercise the message catalog: provider status, routing proof, and single-symbol emission for a given locale. ; syntax=SET MESSAGE CATALOG CHECK|STATUS | SET MESSAGE PROOF <args> | SET MESSAGE EMIT <symbol> [LOCALE <locale>]
summary=SEEK stays exact while NEAR is OFF. When ON, SEEK/FIND may use nearest greater-or-equal ordered-key behaviour. ; syntax=SET NEAR ON|OFF ; aliases=SETNEAR
summary=Routed to the SETORDER handler. Tag 0 clears the controlling order. Present only when the index subsystem is compiled in. ; syntax=SET ORDER TO <tag|0> ; build-gate=DOTTALK_HAS_XINDEX
summary=Page long output at the console. ; syntax=SET PAGING ON|OFF
summary=Routed to the SETPATH handler. Governs the DBF path protocol: SETPATH DBF <dir> then BARE table names. ; syntax=SET PATH <slot> <path>
summary=Enable background polling behaviour. ; syntax=SET POLLING ON|OFF

summary=Fox-style alias for PRN TO FILE / PRN OFF. SET PRINT ON with no prior TO <file> reports that a file is required rather than silently doing nothing. ; syntax=SET PRINT ON|OFF | SET PRINT TO <file>

summary=Singular form, routed to cmd_SET_RELATION. Distinct handler from the plural SET RELATIONS -- they are not spellings of one another. ; syntax=SET RELATION <args...> ; build-gate=DOTTALK_WITH_DEV

summary=Plural form. REWRITTEN BEFORE DISPATCH: preprocess_for_dispatch turns `SET RELATIONS <args>` into `REL <args>`, so this reaches the native relation engine (the cmd_rel.cpp house-SQL family), NOT the ladder arm below. Contrast the SINGULAR SET RELATION, which is not rewritten and is the VFP-compatibility front-end over relations_api. ; syntax=SET RELATIONS <args...> ; build-gate=DOTTALK_WITH_DEV

summary=Enable or disable table buffering for the current work area, or for every open area with ALL. Requires an engine; reports the area number it acted on. ; syntax=SET TABLE BUFFER ON|OFF | SET TABLE BUFFER ON|OFF ALL
summary=Show or suppress per-command progress chatter. ; syntax=SET TALK ON|OFF
summary=Report elapsed time per command. Routed through the canonical executor so in-script timing matches interactive timing. ; syntax=SET TIMER ON|OFF
summary=Routed to the SET_UNIQUE handler; see that command for argument detail. ; syntax=SET UNIQUE FIELD <name> ON|OFF
summary=Print the SET subcommand surface. Also the bare-SET behaviour: SET with no option prints the same text. ; syntax=SET | SET USAGE | SET HELP | SET ? ; aliases=HELP; ?
summary=Wrap output lines at the console width instead of truncating. ; syntax=SET WRAP ON|OFF
